title: Undirected cube edges
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let a dimension edge in direction $i$ be an edge of the Boolean cube that changes only coordinate $i$. The set of undirected cube edges is the set of pairs consisting of a coordinate $i$ and a dimension edge in direction $i$.
